_comment: Intentionally shared MCP servers for every agent on this host. Secrets never live here — use ${env:NAME} placeholders. install.py upserts each named server into ~/.cursor/mcp.json, ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json and ~/.claude.json (mcpServers) without removing unrelated entries (Cursor marketplace plugins, personal servers). Add a server here only when it should reach Claude, Cursor and Antigravity alike.
